title: A PRAYER FOR
YOUR CHILDREN
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer

scenes.a: You carry quiet worries for your children tonight.
And he blessed Joseph, and said, God, before whom my fathers Abraham and Isaac did walk,
the God which fed me all my life long unto this day,
The Angel which redeemed me from all evil, bless the lads;
and let my name be named on them, and the name of my fathers Abraham and Isaac;
and let them grow into a multitude in the midst of the earth.
Heavenly Father, redeem our home from evil and nourish our children all their days.
Keep their hearts secure in Your grace. Amen. You carry quiet worries for your children tonight.
